questions: What per-call cost does SecurityPipeline add to every Runtime::infer (B-33)?

findings.detail: Runtime::infer runs scan_prompt+sanitize_output per call (runtime_facade.rs:66,77) - unmeasured.

cost = regex x input size; bench small/medium/large.
sanitize_output size curve decides B-36 (streaming re-sanitize O(n^2) if per-call linear).
